# SION Consulting

> SION Consulting is a recruitment agency (Personalvermittlung) for companies in Germany. We find workers for transport, logistics, cleaning, construction, kitchens, production and back-office work and place them in direct employment with the client company – no temporary agency work (keine Arbeitnehmerüberlassung). Candidates come from Germany, the EU, the Western Balkans and non-EU countries such as India and Uzbekistan.

Key facts:
- Service: recruitment into direct employment (Personalvermittlung). Not temporary staffing.
- Clients: companies in all of Germany (e.g. Bavaria, Baden-Württemberg, North Rhine-Westphalia, Hesse, Lower Saxony).
- Payment: one-off placement fee per employee, no deposit; invoice only after 30 working days; nothing to pay if the employee leaves before then.
- Response time: reply to staff requests within 1 working day.
- Languages: German and English.
- Candidates from abroad: we support documents for the Federal Employment Agency, visa procedure, arrival and onboarding. No legal advice; authorities decide.
- Staff requests: https://www.sionconsulting.de/kontakt/#anfrage or info@sionconsulting.de
- Job applications (candidates): bewerbung@sionconsulting.de
- Office: Rruga Jordan Misja nr. 116, 1001 Tirana, Albania

## Trades we recruit for (German pages)
- [LKW-Fahrer / Berufskraftfahrer C/CE](https://www.sionconsulting.de/lkw-fahrer/): truck drivers with C/CE and Code 95
- [LKW-Fahrer aus dem Westbalkan](https://www.sionconsulting.de/lkw-fahrer-westbalkan/): drivers under the Western Balkans regulation
- [Paketzusteller](https://www.sionconsulting.de/paketzusteller/): parcel and courier drivers, licence B
- [Lager & Logistik](https://www.sionconsulting.de/lager-logistik/): warehouse workers, order pickers, forklift drivers
- [Reinigung](https://www.sionconsulting.de/reinigung/): cleaners for building, office, hotel and industrial cleaning
- [Bau](https://www.sionconsulting.de/bau/): construction helpers, bricklayers, drywall installers, electricians, painters, civil engineering (Tiefbau)
- [Küche & Gastronomie](https://www.sionconsulting.de/kueche-gastronomie/): kitchen helpers, dishwashers, commis cooks, cooks for restaurants, hotels, canteens, catering
- [Helfer & Produktion](https://www.sionconsulting.de/helfer-produktion/): production and assembly helpers, general workers
- [Saisonarbeit](https://www.sionconsulting.de/saisonarbeit/): seasonal workers for up to 8 months
- [Back Office](https://www.sionconsulting.de/back-office/): administrative support for SMEs
- [Personalvermittlung overview](https://www.sionconsulting.de/personalvermittlung/)
